ai_disabled: AI assistance is turned off for this organization. Ask your admin.
ai_not_configured: AI is not set up yet. An admin needs to enter a model and an API key.
ai_quota_exceeded: This month's AI quota is used up. It resets at the start of the month.
ai_provider_error: The AI model could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
ai_refused: The model did not answer this request. Change the text and try again.
ai_run_not_found: This AI result was not found or was already recorded.
ai_transcription_not_configured: No speech recognition server is set up. Ask your admin.
ai_recording_not_ready: The recording is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
ai_action_unverified: The action ran but its result could not be verified. Check the target.
